next_item_hypothesis: Demonstrated failure: a single flat residual-quantization hierarchy may allocate first-level codes to broad content similarity while failing to preserve sparse, directed train-transition neighborhoods, so an anchor's next item can fall outside its first-token bucket despite being a plausible transition successor. The train-only evidence records 323633 directed pairs, 314605 with no observed reverse event, and mean next-item entropy 4.844072338042215 bits; these observations motivate but do not prove this failure or a curvature effect. Hypothesis: a negatively curved code-assignment geometry can allocate radial/angular capacity to nested, branching successor structure and improve first-token positive hits, while retaining globally fixed item codes. Stage2 constructs item SIDs only; Stage3 T5 performs next-item ranking.

math_definition.architecture: Frozen content encoder f_theta(item) -> h in R^32, followed by three residual vector-quantization levels with 256 learned code vectors per level and one global ordered three-token SID (k1,k2,k3) per item. Codebooks, encoder, optimizer, initialization, epochs, batch size, schedule, seeds, and budget are exactly the existing frozen Stage2 configuration; no additional training protocol is introduced. No prefix Transformer, beam search, recommendation metric optimization, or user bootstrap is present.
math_definition.geometry_and_domain: One implementation has scalar curvature parameter c. Freeze c=1 for the hyperbolic arm and c=0 for the flat arm; freeze epsilon=1e-5 and R=1-epsilon. Define P_R(v)=v when ||v||<=R and P_R(v)=R*v/max(||v||, tiny) otherwise, with tiny the smallest positive normal value of the implementation dtype. Every vector entering any scored distance, including residual targets and code vectors, is first mapped through P_R; both arms therefore use the same closed bounded Euclidean representation domain and map. For c>0 this lies strictly within the unit Poincare ball. No additional projection is inserted between scoring and residual subtraction.
math_definition.scored_distance: For projected x,y define the sole scored quantity, squared distance, D_c^2(x,y)=d_c(x,y)^2=(1/c)*arcosh(1+2*c*||x-y||^2/((1-c*||x||^2)*(1-c*||y||^2)))^2. Compute arcosh(z)=log1p((z-1)+sqrt((z-1)*(z+1))) for z>=1, clamp each nonnegative radicand factor to zero against roundoff, and clamp the argument z below to 1 before evaluation. Objective uses this squared power in both arms. Its exact c->0 limit is D_0^2=4*||x-y||^2; the unsquared distance tends to 2*||x-y||. The c=0 path directly evaluates the limit and never evaluates 1/c. The exponential map is used only for c>0: exp_x^c(v)=x mobiusplus_c ((tanh(sqrt(c)*lambda_x^c*||v||/2)/(sqrt(c)*||v||))*v), lambda_x^c=2/(1-c*||x||^2), with zero-vector coefficient lambda_x^c/2. Its c->0 limit is the identity update x+v. Projection radius (1-epsilon)/sqrt(c) is undefined at c=0; flat arm applies the same fixed P_R to every vector and uses the identity exponential-map limit, not a curvature-dependent radius. Domain policy: reject non-finite inputs before projection; clamp only roundoff in the arcosh evaluation as specified; no out-of-domain c>0 vectors reach the distance.
math_definition.assignment_and_residual_order: Let z_i=P_R(f_theta(item_i)) and q_lk=P_R(e_lk). At each level l, with current residual r_i^(l), first map the residual target into the common domain x_i^(l)=P_R(r_i^(l)); assign k_i,l=argmin_k D_c^2(x_i^(l),q_lk), breaking ties by smallest code index; form the selected code q_i,l=q_l,k_i,l; subtract in the ambient coordinates u_i^(l+1)=x_i^(l)-q_i,l; then map/project the residual update for the next level r_i^(l+1)=P_R(u_i^(l+1)). Thus every residual step is map, project, assign, subtract, then project before it can be scored at the following step. The frozen SID is the tuple of three assigned indices. The same order and code path are used at c=0; there the distance is its flat limit and exponential-map updates, if used by the implementation, are identity updates followed by P_R.

loss_equations.name: quantization_reconstruction_commitment
loss_equations.tensors_and_reduction: I_train is the set of training items in the current batch, N=|I_train|>0; z_i and x_i^(l), q_i,l are 32-vectors defined above; sg is stop-gradient. beta is unchanged from frozen Stage2. Sums are explicitly normalized over item, level where applicable, and latent coordinate as shown, then added. Empty batch is an invalid training batch and produces no optimizer step (no zero-filled loss).
loss_equations.circularity: Assignments and residual targets are computed from current parameters without gradients and detached for the entire loss evaluation; the selected codes are then treated as fixed indices. This breaks target/assignment dependence on parameters within each gradient calculation.

loss_equations.name: train_transition_prefix_prior
loss_equations.tensors_and_reduction: T is the multiset of ordered adjacent item transitions (u,v) from the training split only, with u the preceding item and v the next item; counts n_train(u,v,a) and n_train(u,a) count transitions whose target has first code a, and denominators n_train(u,v), n_train(u) are corresponding transition totals. The categorical support is codes {0,...,255}; Laplace alpha=1. If T is empty, L_tr is exactly zero and adds no gradient.
loss_equations.circularity: All SID codes used for counts are generated by a frozen, detached copy of the current assignment map at the start of the epoch and held fixed while the epoch's parameters update; assignments are refreshed only at the next epoch boundary. Thus the transition target distribution has no within-step dependence on trainable parameters.

math_definition.total_objective: L=L_q+gamma*L_tr, where gamma is the existing frozen Stage2 loss weight if one exists; otherwise gamma=1, selected once before either arm and held identical. No other objective or protocol changes.

hyperbolic_necessity: The measured asymmetry and entropy are consistent with a branching, non-reversible transition structure, for which negative curvature is a plausible capacity allocation: exponential volume growth can separate divergent branches while preserving shared coarse prefixes. This is a testable geometric rationale, not a deduction from pair counts; literature evidence directly establishes feasibility of hyperbolic residual semantic-ID generation and reports author-reported long-tail results, but neither source proves curvature is necessary for this dataset. The train-transition prefix prior is included identically in both arms to avoid attributing a transition signal to geometry.
euclidean_control: The control is the identical implementation, architecture, parameter count, initialization, training data, transition signal, optimizer, schedule, seeds, and compute budget with c=0. It uses the exact squared-distance limit 4*||x-y||^2, identity exponential-map limit, the same P_R and residual operation order, and the same losses and targets. It differs only in distance formula/curvature parameter; there is no graph arm.
effect_site: Stage2 code assignment and codebook geometry, specifically first-token grouping under train-transition supervision; reconstruction/commitment remains the same squared Euclidean latent reconstruction loss in both arms. Expected diagnostic movement is increased valid L1 positive hit rate and Hard-L1 ER, increased level2 distinct prefixes, reduced L3 collision, increased L3 refinement gain, and increased conditional G3. These are diagnostics, not proof of ranking benefit.
real_trigger_measurement: Compute only on the frozen validation pairs of 52855 (one positive and ten negatives per anchor, seed 42, history[-1] -> target). Valid L1 positive hit rate is the share for which the anchor item's first SID token equals the positive item's first token. Valid Hard-L1 ER is 10*positive_hits/negative_hits, where negative_hits uses the same equality on all ten negatives. level2_distinct_prefixes is the number of unique (k1,k2) tuples over all items (reference 16145). L3 collision is the share of items whose (k1,k2,k3) tuple is shared with another item. L3 refinement gain is the mean over items of log2(|bucket(k1,k2)|/|bucket(k1,k2,k3)|). Conditional G3 is the mean over validation pairs of log2(p_hist(L3 target|anchor)/p_pref(L3 target|target prefix2)), with the train-transition history term mixed into a Laplace-smoothed alpha=1 over 256 codes prefix prior. No validation/test behavior enters fitting or SID construction.
training_only_inputs: Content item embeddings and training-split item transitions only. No validation/test behavior, future event, prediction-time user context, or batch-composition signal is used as a model input or supervision. Validation pairs are used solely for the frozen diagnostic and registered Stage3 behavioral evaluation. Every item receives one stable global SID independent of user, batch, or request.

stage2_diagnostics.name: valid_L1_positive_hit_rate
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: For each paired frozen training seed, candidate minus flat-control value; aggregate by arithmetic mean across the preregistered existing seeds.

stage2_diagnostics.name: valid_Hard_L1_ER
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: For each paired frozen training seed, candidate minus flat-control value; aggregate by arithmetic mean across the preregistered existing seeds.

stage2_diagnostics.name: level2_distinct_prefixes
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: For each paired frozen training seed, candidate minus flat-control value; aggregate by arithmetic mean across the preregistered existing seeds.

stage2_diagnostics.name: L3_collision
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: For each paired frozen training seed, flat-control minus candidate value; aggregate by arithmetic mean across the preregistered existing seeds.

stage2_diagnostics.name: L3_refinement_gain
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: For each paired frozen training seed, candidate minus flat-control value; aggregate by arithmetic mean across the preregistered existing seeds.

stage2_diagnostics.name: conditional_G3
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: For each paired frozen training seed, candidate minus flat-control value; aggregate by arithmetic mean across the preregistered existing seeds.

stage3_behavioral_test.seed_rule: Paired candidate-minus-flat-control test_R@10 on identical frozen Stage3 seeds and protocol; aggregate by arithmetic mean across the preregistered existing seeds. Evaluate once after SIDs and Stage2 diagnostics are frozen; no selection or tuning on test results.

classification.falsified_if: any registered stage2_diagnostics threshold is met in the opposite direction OR the registered stage3_behavioral_test threshold is met in the opposite direction
classification.passed_if: all registered stage2_diagnostics thresholds are met in their registered directions AND the registered stage3_behavioral_test threshold is met in its registered direction
classification.mixed_if: at least one registered threshold is met in its registered direction AND at least one other registered threshold is met in the opposite direction, with no NULL comparison

null_outcome_rule: If any seed-wise or aggregated change is undefined or non-finite (including zero denominator, missing evaluation, or empty stratum), classify that result NULL. Any comparison containing any NULL seed is inconclusive, neither passed nor falsified; it cannot satisfy the mixed classification.
